payout_quote: If you refer a friend, family member or co-worker to MVFCU we will give you $25 and them $25.
steps: Be a Minnesota Valley FCU member
Refer a friend, family member, or co-worker; existing member must be directly responsible for them signing up
New member opens membership with a qualifying loan of $2,500+ (or $500+ if age 15-22) or a deposit of $2,500+ at account opening
New member maintains the balance for at least 3 months
$25 deposited to the existing member's share savings (S1) and $25 to the new member
catches: Referral must bring a qualifying loan ($2,500+) or deposit ($2,500+) — just opening an account is not enough
Member must maintain the balance for at least 3 months
New member must present the coupon when opening membership
Membership eligibility: live, work, worship or attend school in Blue Earth, Nicollet, or Le Sueur Counties
biggest_catch: A simple membership is not enough — your friend needs a $2,500 loan or $2,500 deposit, held for 3 months, to trigger your $25.
eligibility: Minnesota Valley FCU members; referred friends must qualify for membership and meet loan/deposit thresholds
timing: Timing not stated on the flyer
